privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: What personal data thomasboue.com collects, why, for how long, and how to exercise your rights.

sections.heading: Data controller
paragraphs: The data controller is {{publisherName}}, publisher of {{siteUrl}}. Contact for any question about personal data: {{contactEmail}}.

sections.heading: Contact form
paragraphs: Data: the name, email address and message you enter.
Purpose: replying to your request (job, project, question).
Legal basis: legitimate interest in answering messages received through the site (GDPR article 6.1.f).
Retention: 12 months after receipt, then automatic deletion.
Recipients: {{publisherName}}; the host {{hostName}} (database storage); and the email provider Resend, which forwards the message notification to the publisher.

sections.heading: Audience measurement
paragraphs: Data: page viewed, referring site, country (derived from the IP address), device type, browser, and an anonymous identifier computed from the IP address and browser with a salt that changes every day. The IP address is never stored, and the identifier cannot follow you from one day to the next.
Purpose: knowing how much the site is visited, without profiling or advertising. These statistics are produced by the site itself, with no third-party tool, and are not combined with other data.
Legal basis: legitimate interest (GDPR article 6.1.f). This measurement uses no cookie or tracker and falls under the consent exemption for strictly statistical audience measurement.
Retention: 13 months at most, then automatic deletion.
Right to object: you can opt out at any time with the checkbox at the bottom of this page.

sections.heading: Server logs
paragraphs: Data: IP address, date and requested URL, recorded by the servers to keep the site secure and running.
Legal basis: legitimate interest (service security). Retention: 12 months at most. Access: the publisher and the host {{hostName}}.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: This site sets no cookie or tracker that requires consent: no advertising, no social network widget, no third-party analytics, no font or video loaded from another domain. That is why no consent banner is shown.

It only uses your browser's local storage (localStorage) to remember your language, your light or dark theme and, if you chose it, your opt-out from audience measurement. This information stays in your browser and is never sent to a server.

sections.heading: Transfers outside the European Union
paragraphs: The site is hosted by {{hostName}} within the European Union. The email provider Resend is based in the United States, so the content of a contact message may be transferred to it, under the safeguards provided by the GDPR (standard contractual clauses).

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You have the rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability over your data. To exercise them, write to {{contactEmail}}; you will get an answer within one month.
If you believe your rights are not respected, you can lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority: https://www.cnil.fr/en/make-a-complaint.
